name: Hillsbrad Foothills
summary: Hillsbrad Foothills remains green while war tears through the last pastoral reaches of Lordaeron. Southshore's humans and the Forsaken at Tarren Mill clash across the fields, making the region a violent crossroads for Alliance and Horde armies.

sections.title: A Garden Beside the Ruins
sections.body: Hillsbrad remains green while blight consumes much of northern Lordaeron. Rolling pastures, pine groves, and working farms still recall the kingdom before the Third War. Armed patrols, rogue mercenaries, and scavenger beasts cross its fields and roads. Lordaeron's breadbasket has become one of its most contested borderlands.

sections.title: The War of Southshore and Tarren Mill
sections.body: Southshore stands on the southern coast, held by human refugees and soldiers loyal to the Alliance. North of it, Tarren Mill was once a quiet human farming hamlet, until the Scourge destroyed it and the Forsaken fortified it as their southernmost garrison. The open ground between the settlements has become a relentless killing ground, where Alliance and Horde champions skirmish for control of Hillsbrad.

sections.title: Old Scars and Hidden Threats
sections.body: Hillsbrad's violence reaches back to the Second War, when its coast and hills saw the first massive clashes between the Grand Alliance and the Old Horde. Durnholde Keep later served as the internment camp where Thrall was raised before leading the orcish rebellion. Now the keep lies in ruins, held by the Syndicate, displaced human nobles turned bandits. Coastal murlocs, hostile gnolls, and the shadowed dead on Purgation Isle leave no corner of the hills secure.

faq.q: Why isn't Hillsbrad blighted like the rest of Lordaeron?
faq.answer: The Scourge marched mainly through the central corridors toward the capital and northern kingdoms, leaving Hillsbrad largely beyond the reach of the plague cauldrons that ruined the north. Its soil remains fertile and its vegetation healthy, making it the most pristine remnant of old Lordaeron.

Neither faction controls all of Hillsbrad. The Alliance holds Southshore and nearby farms such as the Hillsbrad Fields, while the Forsaken hold Tarren Mill to the north. Dwarven forces occupy Dun Garok in the east, and the criminal Syndicate holds the ruins of Durnholde Keep.

Durnholde once served as the headquarters of the Alliance's internment camp system after the Second War. Aedelas Blackmoore governed it and raised Thrall there as a gladiator slave. Thrall escaped, rallied the orcs, and laid waste to the keep; after Lordaeron fell, the Syndicate occupied its ruins.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken and humans fight so fiercely here?
faq.answer: Tarren Mill marks the southern frontier of Sylvanas Windrunner's domain, while Southshore is the Alliance's main staging ground and port into Lordaeron. The Forsaken see Southshore as a threat to their southern flank, and the humans see the undead as usurpers who must be driven from their homeland.

Purgation Isle is a rugged, isolated island off Hillsbrad's southern coast. Powerful undead ghouls, skeletons, and vengeful spirits infest it, making it a dangerous offshore refuge for dark magic and restless dead.

faq.q: Who are the bandits occupying the camps and towers?
faq.answer: The bandits belong to the Syndicate, an organized network of former nobles and foot soldiers from the fallen human kingdom of Alterac. Cast out after their kingdom's betrayal during the Second War, they now seek to reclaim their lands through blackmail, theft, and slaughter.

angles.text: Southshore is one of your people's last refuges in Lordaeron. These pastures recall the great kingdom lost to betrayal and undeath.
Tarren Mill anchors the southern frontier of the Forsaken realm. Apothecary Lydon works there to develop the New Plague and secure your people's future.
Durnholde Keep's ruined ramparts mark where Warchief Thrall broke his chains and rekindled the spirit of the Horde.
The soldiers of Dun Garok show Ironforge's resolve to defend its human allies and contain the undead threat north of the Wetlands.
Ravenholdt Manor lies hidden in the mountains above the foothills. It is the secret gathering place and training ground of Azeroth's most elite guild of thieves and assassins.
